title: Chapter 104 Loyalty And Loyalty
content:
Chapter 104 Loyalty And Loyalty

With the rapid advance of Patriarch Edel, he is getting closer and closer to the location of his target Zhong Yu. Soon, 1000 meters, 500 meters, 300 meters, 100 meters will come to Zhong Yu's place. in front of it.

The guards behind them also had high morale, and rushed forward with their leader excitedly, wanting to capture and kill the leader of the army in front together, and later win the war.

When patriarch Edel was 100 meters away from Zhong Yu, it was already very difficult to force those soldiers to back down with his fierce power. Behind these soldiers is His Majesty, the supreme emperor of their kingdom. If they really give in, and hand over His Majesty to such a fierce and powerful person, how unimaginable the consequences will be?

And even if they escaped with their current lives, after returning, their relatives were still in the hands of His Majesty the Emperor, and if they escaped back, His Majesty the Emperor would lose. What other powers in the whole imperial kingdom can stop these barbarians? In the end it wasn't a dead one!

Therefore, these soldiers resisted to the death at this moment, and broke out with incredible bravery. Soldiers who understood that they had no way to retreat no longer grudged their own lives at this moment, but did everything they could to stop the monstrous monster in front of them. people step forward.

Patriarch Edel swiped down the heavy sword in his hand, bringing out a khaki-yellow light, and cut several soldiers standing in front of him into two. endlessly.

However, the tragic situation in front of them did not make the soldiers at the back give in. Instead, they were even more stimulated to rush up and fight desperately.

Although all of this is meaningless, the life of the soldiers is uselessly consumed at this moment, and it cannot bring a trace of scars to the inhumanly powerful patriarch Edel, but instead loses his precious life.

But all of this is not useless, at least they have successfully delayed the footsteps of Patriarch Edel with their own lives, and it is difficult for him who could advance quickly to advance even ten steps.

The soldiers died quickly under his hands, but there are countless thousands of soldiers behind him, waiting for his arrival, forming a human wall layer by layer, airtight Standing in front of him and Zhong Yu.

If Patriarch Edel wants to kill Zhong Yu, he must cross this human wall. This is destined to be a very difficult project. Even if 10,000 pigs stand in front of you for you to see, you will have to work hard to chop them down. It would take him months to hack to death.

What's more, you still hold a weapon, and you won't let you slaughter a fighter who has mastered elite killing skills! Patriarch Edel wanted to kill them, although it was easy, but it was accompanied by the physical strength consumed by each swing and the power provided by the sharp deceleration fighting spirit in his body.

It has been about half an hour since he joined the battlefield just now. Every time he swings his weapon to slash, he will consume his physical strength and fighting spirit. Such a long consumption, although for his fourth-order For the strong, it is not fatal.

But it is also a big burden, and now with his current situation, if he wants to kill tens of thousands of people in front of him, it is not because Zhong Yu looks down on him, but because it is really difficult. It was a fifth-order powerhouse who came, and even when he didn't open his domain, he was still very weak. At most, he could only retreat with his whole body.

Now that patriarch Edel is surrounded by heavy siege, with hundreds of thousands of his soldiers on the left and right forming a human wall to block his retreat, encircling him airtight, except for a part of the battlefield left in the middle to surround and kill him, the rest The soldiers in the distance were crowded with people, and they circled dozens of meters wide for him, leaving no gaps at all to prevent him from escaping.

And the three hundred soldiers who came with him before were dispatched by Zhong Yu to the elite troops early on to stop the strangulation. They didn't have any extraordinary power at all, and they only reached the first level by virtue of their honed killing skills. And where is Zhong Yu's opponent who has more killing skills, better equipment, and a larger army than him!

At this moment, everything has been completely lost, and they have been submerged in the crowd of Zhong Yu's army early on. Except for the corpses of Zhong Yu's army lying on the ground and their corpses to prove their existence, no one pays attention to them at this moment. , all looked in the direction of Patriarch Edel.

Swing down one after another, Patriarch Edel has forgotten how many people he killed, and the number is uncountable. It has been two hours since he joined the battlefield and killed until now.

And every time he swung his sword, he would take away the lives of four or five enemy soldiers, but those enemy soldiers seemed to not care about their own lives, and used their bodies to block his sword without hesitation. , as if deliberately using their lives to consume their physical strength and fighting spirit.

Up to now, Patriarch Edel has forgotten how many times he has swung his sword, three hundred, six hundred, one thousand, or how much, he has lost count, only knows that his hands are very tired now, and the muscles all over his body It was very numb, and he had already lost consciousness, but the belief in his heart made him persist in waving his hands like a machine.

And there were more and more corpses of soldiers around him, layer by layer, and soon formed several hills, which were caused by his attempts to break out in several directions. A mountain of people formed by the corpses of several soldiers was piled up there.

Sitting on top of his own yoke, he looked peacefully at his soldiers besieging and besieging the leader of the Edel Alliance, only to find that he was so powerful that he had already killed more than 3,000 elite soldiers under his command in just two hours. soldiers.

With such a combat power, even Zhong Yu, who is also at the fourth rank, has to marvel at his bravery and offer him admiration and respect in his heart.

But this is of no use. For Zhong Yu, whose heart has long been as hard as iron and stone, his years of emperor career have already honed his disposition to regard human life as worthless.

In the world of the Three Kingdoms, tens of millions of people died because of his single order, how could the mere 3,000 people in front of him make his heart like stagnant water stir up waves again!

Therefore, he still operated his own exercises silently, allowing its influence to slowly permeate the soldiers around the patriarch Edel, and made hints in their hearts that in order to protect His Majesty the Emperor, even if he tried his best Everything, even if you lose your life, everything is for His Majesty the Emperor!

That's right, the reason why those soldiers are so unafraid of death, facing such a ferocious humanoid beast, they dared to rush up with all their lives, seems to have put fear and life and death aside, didn't care about anything at all, all they wanted was to exhaust themselves Patriarch Edel's physical strength is the same as grudge.

It is not the so-called loyalty and the protection of His Majesty's life, but Zhong Yu who has been silently operating his skills behind him, allowing his influence to penetrate into the depths of every soldier's heart, in his subconscious It had an influence, causing those soldiers to go against their will and make extraordinary actions.

Otherwise, let alone these ancient soldiers who are somewhat of a feudal army, although their discipline and morale have been rigorously trained by Zhong Yu for several years, they are already similar to modern soldiers!

But as long as it is a creature, it is absolutely impossible to face the irresistible powerful terror, and the innate awe of the strong, knowing that it is dead, and rushing forward!

All of this is due to Zhong Yu's heaven-defying kung fu, Tianyi Emperor Kung Fu!
